preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 5,000,000 inclusive.
The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(s[i:j][::-1] + s[j:] for i in range(len(s)+1) for j in range(i, len(s)+1) if (j-i) <= len(s) and (len(s) - (j-i)) <= (k-1) * len(s))
postconditions.description: The output string is the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained by splitting s into at most k non-empty substrings and reversing some of them.
